title_ja: 当社グループにおける個人情報の漏えいについて
title_en: Leak of personal information at our group
summary_en: On 30 August 2024, Dai-ichi Life Holdings disclosed two improper data transfers involving its group insurance agency Alpha Consulting. Staff seconded from Dai-ichi Life passed policy numbers for about 37,000 Alpha customers to Dai-ichi Life between September 2020 and July 2024. Staff seconded from Sompo Japan passed about 490 customers' details (policy numbers, names, addresses, phone numbers and insurer names) to Sompo Japan between June 2020 and May 2023. The company says no secondary use or customer harm has been confirmed, and it is investigating whether similar cases exist.

title_en: Start of handling of the internet-only single-premium individual annuity "プレミアカレンシー３楽天銀行エディション" (Premier Currency 3 Rakuten Bank Edition) through Rakuten Bank
summary_en: Daiichi Frontier Life and Rakuten Bank announced that from June 15, 2026 they will sell "Premier Currency 3 Rakuten Bank Edition". It is a single-premium, currency-designated individual annuity with a variable accumulation rate, and the two companies developed it together. Rakuten Bank sells it as the agent, and Daiichi Frontier Life underwrites it. The whole process, from application to contract completion, can be done online (service hours 7:00–25:00). The release says the online process lets the companies cut some sales and administrative costs and reflect that in the product design.
